title: Appointment Friction Ping
oneLiner: Replace a frustrating medical phone bot with one SMS question that routes today’s real arrival blocker to a usable next step.
targetUser: Clinics, pharmacies, and high-cost appointment teams serving anxious, multilingual, or first-time visitors.
keyUX: Send one respectful blocker question, branch to a tiny arrival-help card, and escalate only unresolved exceptions.
